name: Positive Teaching Dimension
definition: The **Positive Teaching Dimension** is the largest, over $h\in\mathcal{H}$, minimum size of a teaching set for $h$ that uses only positive examples of $h$.
graph_summary: Worst-case minimum size of a teaching set restricted to positive examples.
origin_references: Positive-example variants of teaching dimension are studied in \cite{balbach2008measuring}.

monotonic.proof: A positive teaching set for a target in a class remains a positive teaching set after restricting to a subfamily. Taking the maximum over the remaining targets cannot increase the value.

c_monotonic.proof: Restrict a positive teaching set to unfixed coordinates.  It is still positive and distinguishes the target inside the conditioned fibre.
